name: Julie Adams
quote: Elizabeth was referred to us through our Washington State realtor for a home purchase in Oregon. Elizabeth did not disappoint. She is professional and knowledgeable throughout the entire home search and purchasing process. She was always honest and upfront when we asked her questions. She responded quickly to all of our inquiries and always followed through with what we were asking of her in a timely manner. We would highly recommend Elizabeth for any real-estate transaction. She was lovely to work with.

name: Tasha Vanelli
quote: Elizabeth is an absolute GEM. She was highly recommended to me by a family friend and boy, did she deliver! Her knowledge of the market is top-notch. She understood our vision and what we were looking for and never wasted our time or try to push us in another direction. She was very patient with us (we are first time home buyers). We were very stressed out and nervous and had no idea what we were doing, but she educated us on everything and answered ALL of our questions. It was a truly wonderful experience. I would recommend Elizabeth to anyone and everyone. First time buyers, experience buyers, etc. Thank you, Elizabeth!!!

name: Monica Donlan
quote: We worked with Elizabeth three times in the last three years - buying our first house, selling the house, and buying our dream custom build home. In each case, Elizabeth made the normally stressful experience go by incredibly smoothly. Her knowledge of the area, market, negotiation skills, and each family’s needs really helped us find the perfect home twice and sell exactly within our timeline at more than the expected value for the home. You honestly cannot go wrong having Elizabeth on your team or taking her advice. We are incredibly thankful to have had her in our corner each time!

name: Mark Ratliff
quote: Elizabeth had helped my daughter find a new home on two occasions. She highly recommended her to me when I was in the market for a condo. She was very knowledgeable about what was available and gave me a nice variety of options to consider. It didn't take long for her to find me exactly what I was looking for. I've purchased several homes in the past and this was by far the best experience I've had. She did a great job negotiating the purchase. I felt like I was her most important client. I couldn't imagine better service. Anyone would be hard pressed to find a better agent.

name: Brian Plett
quote: Elizabeth was an indispensable asset in both selling and buying a home for us. She helped us navigate through the process and was always quick to answer any questions we had. When issues came up in the inspection, she quickly lined up contractors in that specialty to get an accurate estimate for the repair. We would definitely work with her again in the future.

name: Meghann Bunce
quote: It’s hard to put into words how incredible an experience it was working with Elizabeth. Entering the housing market during the spring of 2021 would have been completely daunting, if it weren’t for being guided through it by Elizabeth. She was so patient as we saw each home, waiting for the right one. Even when we had to bring our three small children to showings. When we found our dream home, Elizabeth drafted up such a creative offer that the sellers excepted immediately! She then walked us through the selling process just as seamlessly. She was determined to get us the price we wanted for our home. And she delivered!

name: Meghann Bunce
quote:
Her in depth knowledge about every last detail was both astounding and reassuring. She returns calls, texts and emails with impressive speed and made us feel so supported throughout each step of the process. My husband is a hard to please, detailed oriented kind of guy and he was floored by Elizabeth’s professionalism, knowledge and dedication. She treats her clients like family (I mean, she got us and our kids welcome home gifts at our new house!) and she goes above and beyond to make sure they get everything they want out of the home buying process.

If you are in the process of looking for a realtor or even thinking about buying or selling a home, run, don’t walk and call Elizabeth. You will not regret it!

name: Lane Elliott
quote: Elizabeth helped us purchase our first home in 2015. She was wonderful at explaining and helping us through the steps of buying our 1st place. More recently she helped us purchase our next home in a highly competitive market but also sold our original home as well.

name: Mark Ewald
quote: Once again, Elizabeth provided us with outstanding service. This time she coordinated for us in both a sell and a purchase in downtown Portland. She consistently prepared us for all contingencies in the selling and buying that needed to take place on the same day. It all went smooth without a hitch. We found Elizabeth thoroughly prepared and informed when helping us clarify our ideal living location and needs. From start to finish, Elizabeth and her team was there to successfully guide us through both real estate transactions.

name: Kimbery Evans Stormberg
quote:
We were so happy to work with Elizabeth on both our home purchase and sale. The whole process was overwhelming, but she kept us going and kept reminding us to prioritize what would make our life easier and more enjoyable in our new home. We have now been in our new home for 1 week and I feel more at home here than I ever did at the last home we owned for 12 years. She didn't push us to put offers in on places that checked boxes, but just didn't feel right for our family. We ended up with a home that suits us well and is a pleasure to be at!

Elizabeth is very professional with a touch of quirk and a large helping of generosity. Let her help you to get to a happy new phase in your life!
